definition.description: Poll definition schema version 1. Use id "draft" and stable option IDs option:1, option:2, etc. All rules, closing, quorum, ballot delivery and disclosure must be explicit.

closing.description: kind manual, or kind deadline with deadline: {mode:after_publish,durationMinutes} / {mode:at,closesAt ISO timestamp} / {mode:after_first_non_creator_response,durationMinutes,activationTimeoutMinutes}

quorum.description: kind none, absolute with minimumResponses, or percentage with minimumTurnoutBasisPoints

rule.description: decide: plurality, approval, single_non_transferable or multiwinner_approval with seats, approve_reject with approveOptionId/rejectOptionId/minimumApprovalBasisPoints; measure: distribution with allowMultipleAnswers or ordered_scale; count: sum with unit

program.description: Version 1 workflow graph. Each node has id, actionId, version, input, conditions, bindings and dependsOn. Use only declared poll_outcome actions. Option references use stable definition option IDs.

assistant.summary: Guided durable WhatsApp polls with operator presets, aggregate results, and confirmed lifecycle management.

workflows.description: Start the guided Decide, Measure, or Tally setup flow, using an operator-selected poll preset when available.

Open a schedule-deferred automated poll or close a manageable poll through guided selection and confirmation; cancellation and tie resolution remain explicit.
